items.question: Do you want to fly to Sydney or go by train?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Do you want to fly to Sydney or go by train?”，自然应答是“You know | don’t like flying. Bia w”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：A（You know | don’t like flying. Bia w）。
